mapper.sql: id, activity_id, version, content, published_at, published_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgn_activity_snapshot (activity_id, version, content, published_at, published_by) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{version}, CAST(#{content} AS JSON), #{publishedAt}, #{publishedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sgn_activity_snapshot WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY version DESC
